name: LanLens
description: LanLens is a self-hosted network discovery and documentation tool for home labs and small environments.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent LanLens data, including SQLite database, settings, and TLS material.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Optional encryption/signing key for restores or migrations. Leave empty for normal first startup; LanLens will generate and persist a strong key in /data/secret_key.

variables.name: Default Admin Password
variables.description: Initial admin password for first startup. Change it after login.

variables.name: LanLens Web UI Port
variables.description: Host-mode port used by the LanLens Web UI.

variables.name: Backend Port
variables.description: Internal FastAPI backend port behind nginx. Leave unchanged unless there is a port conflict.
